title: Sequencing: committee reports
bodyMd:
Five reports are discussed in successive agenda slots. Each report is discussed once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Budget, Housing, Parks, Roads, Water.

- Exactly 1 other item must occur between Budget and Roads.
- Housing must be immediately followed by Water.
- Parks must not be in position 3.
